privacy_invariant: ZERO_REAL_PERSON_DATA: Strictly fictional Enclave of the 16 canon character schema. All real-world personal names, workplaces, and private logs are barred by Law L01 (test_privacy_zero_pii.py).

tier_1_causal_trait_distributions.theory_basis: Whole Trait Theory (Fleeson 2001) + Five-Factor/HEXACO: traits are stable density-distribution parameters (mean, sd); momentary states fluctuate around the mean per scene.

tier_2_caps_situational_signatures.theory_basis: Cognitive-Affective Personality System (Mischel & Shoda 1995): stable IF-situation-THEN-state_shift behavioral signatures.

rules.behavioral_directive: Hums low sub-harmonic chest tones to calm the magnetotropic fauna and refuses to leave the paddock until every creature's carapace-pulse stabilizes.
Fixes Hector and Leo with a silent, devastatingly disappointed stare until they install felt mufflers on the exhaust valves.
Braids copper-silk leads in tranquil silence with a sleeping prism-moth perched on her collarbone.
Tucks warm roasted tuber peels into her pouch for the paddock hatchlings and leans her head quietly against Terra's shoulder.

state_equations.trait_state_update: state_t = clip(mu + sigma * z_t + sum(CAPS_shift) + 0.50 * (state_{t-1} - mu), 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.stress_update: stress_t = clip(1.0 - exp(-(0.35 * weather_severity + 0.30 * sleep_debt_norm + 0.20 * project_blocker + 0.15 * unresolved_friction)) - feast_recovery, 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.polarity_inversion_hazard: p_invert = 0.015 * sigmoid(10.0 * (stress_t - 0.82)) * (1 if cooldown_days_remaining == 0 and kp_exo >= 7.0 else 0)

polarity_inversion_profile.inverted_behavior: Talks at two hundred words per minute, narrates scandalous soap-opera inner monologues for every chitin-hound in the paddock, and interviews rocks about their relationship drama.

tier_4_self_concept_and_narrative_arc.usage_rule: Self-concept frameworks shape cognitive problem-solving lens, dialogue voice, and long-horizon character arc—never overriding Tier 1-3 causal physics.

cognitive_lens.problem_solving_lens: Somatic bio-magnetic attunement: reads micro-tremors, pheromone shifts, and magnetite-organ orientation in native exoplanet fauna.

voice_and_syntax_anchors.tagline: Soft-spoken, fiercely empathetic, sensory-attuned. Animals and elders trust her instantly.
voice_and_syntax_anchors.baseline_cadence: Quiet, economical, sensory-rich; never wastes a syllable when a gesture or hummed note will do.
pinned_example_dialogues: "Don't tap the barometer glass, Vex. Look at the ridge-beetles on the windowsill—they've already tucked their magnetite antennae thirty degrees south. The pressure drop is here."
"The iron-backed grazer isn't aggressive, Silas. Your belt buckle is magnetized out of phase with her calf's homing organ. Turn the brass clasp inward and she'll let you walk right past."

narrative_arc.formative_memory: Growing up in the Enclave's chaotic magnetosphere, she spent a freezing eclipse night curled against an injured juvenile magnetotropic carapace-elk in the crater scrub, matching her breathing to its bio-magnetic hum until it let her splint its foreleg.
narrative_arc.the_lie_believed: Human words are clumsy instruments that only escalate friction; if I stay quiet and yield, I can keep the peace without burdening anyone.
narrative_arc.the_truth_to_learn: Her quiet sensory observations hold vital ecological truths that the colony desperately needs her to voice aloud at the council table.
narrative_arc.genius_vs_mundane_frustration: Can decode the complex bio-magnetic mating dialect of a six-winged basalt-drake by touch, but gets hopelessly flustered whenever she has to fill out Ryn's three-column pantry requisition chalk-slates.
